title: Dearness Allowance increase for Central Government employees (sample)
paragraphs: The Government has approved an increase in Dearness Allowance from 50 percent to 53 percent of basic pay with effect from 1 January 2025.
The increase is payable to all Central Government employees and pensioners (as Dearness Relief) and will be paid in cash along with the salary of the month in which orders are received.
Arrears for the period January 2025 to the month before the orders are implemented will be paid in a single instalment.

title: Revised travelling allowance rates for official tours (sample)
paragraphs: Employees travelling on official tours are entitled to daily allowance at the revised rate based on the city category of the place of halt.
Claims for travelling allowance must be submitted within 60 days of completion of the journey, along with tickets and the tour programme approved by the controlling officer.

title: Leave Travel Concession clarification (sample)
paragraphs: Leave Travel Concession can be availed once in every block of two years for visiting the home town, and once in a four-year block for any place in India.
An employee must apply to the head of office at least one month before the proposed journey, and an advance of up to 90 percent of the estimated fare may be granted.

title: Pension revision and commutation rules (sample)
paragraphs: A pensioner may commute up to 40 percent of the basic pension, and the commuted portion is restored to the pensioner after fifteen years.
Family pension is payable to the spouse of a deceased employee at 30 percent of last pay drawn, subject to a minimum amount as notified by the Government.

title: Guidelines on inter-state transfer requests (sample)
paragraphs: Requests for inter-state transfer on spouse or medical grounds will be considered by the cadre controlling authority, subject to availability of a vacancy at the requested location.
Applications for transfer should be sent through proper channel with a no-objection certificate from the present office, and supporting documents such as a medical certificate where applicable.

title: Constitution of the 8th Pay Commission (sample)
paragraphs: The Government has announced the constitution of the 8th Pay Commission to examine and recommend changes in the pay structure, allowances and pensions of Central Government employees.
The Commission is expected to submit its recommendations within eighteen months of its constitution, after consulting employee associations and State Governments.
